Objective: Ensure that every assurance claim resolves to an exact system, configuration, context, population, function, actor, and lifecycle state.

Module: Human rights, autonomy, consent, and mental integrity
Objective: Protect dignity, autonomy, freedom of thought, mental and physical integrity, voluntariness, and dynamic consent.

Module: Scientific evidence, claim control, and reproducibility
Objective: Require science- and evidence-based claims, exact endpoints, reproducible methods, limitations, and prohibited inferences.

Module: Safety, benefit-risk, proportionality, and clinical vigilance
Objective: Control physical, mental, social, economic, and lifecycle harms through proportionate benefit-risk evidence and vigilance.

Module: Neural data, mental privacy, and data governance
Objective: Protect direct neural data, indirect neural data, and non-neural data enabling mental-state inference through minimization, purpose limits, access controls, and rights.
Protect hardware, software, data, services, and lifecycle operations against compromise, misuse, failure, and supplier cessation.
Control model provenance, training data, bias, calibration, uncertainty, automation, human oversight, and signal-versus-prior behavior.
Give participants, affected communities, persons with disabilities, caregivers, and civil society meaningful authority throughout the lifecycle.

Module: Equity, accessibility, non-discrimination, and global justice
Objective: Detect and mitigate exclusion, bias, unequal access, stigma, linguistic and cultural barriers, and burdens on resource-constrained settings.

Module: Accountability, independent oversight, remedy, and public transparency
Objective: Assign accountable actors, preserve independent review and dissent, provide remedy, and publish bounded information suitable for public scrutiny.

Module: Lifecycle continuity, withdrawal, post-trial support, and reversibility
Objective: Protect users when systems change, fail, are withdrawn, become obsolete, or require deactivation, removal, maintenance, or continuing access.
Apply heightened controls in education, employment, consumer, children, older-person, disability, mental-health, enhancement, and dual-use settings.

Module: Sustainability, institutional capacity, monitoring, and international cooperation
Objective: Build durable institutions, workforce competence, environmental responsibility, national coordination, indicators, and international learning.
